# Costs

- built: a claude-haiku-5-5 call whose prompt (its input, cache-read and cache-write tokens together) is over 100000 tokens is priced at the table's prompts over 100,000 tokens rows and its record flagged "over 100000 prompt tokens: priced at the table's prompts over 100,000 tokens rows"; the page states the threshold as prompts over 100,000 tokens, and a request's prompt length counts all of its input tokens, cache reads and writes included; priced at these rows under the lane orchestrator's ruling of 25 Oct 2026, the table having marked it not yet ruled
- built: a gpt-6-luna call whose prompt (its input, cache-read and cache-write tokens together) is over 272000 tokens is priced at the table's >272K input tokens rows and its record flagged "over 272000 prompt tokens: priced at the table's >272K input tokens rows"; the page's ">272K input tokens" is read as over 272000 tokens (K as 1000), the lower reading, so a call the page might price short under a reading of K as 1024 is priced long, an over-statement bound
- built: a gpt-6.1-sol call whose prompt (its input, cache-read and cache-write tokens together) is over 272000 tokens is priced at the table's >272K input tokens rows and its record flagged "over 272000 prompt tokens: priced at the table's >272K input tokens rows"; the page's ">272K input tokens" is read as over 272000 tokens (K as 1000), the lower reading, so a call the page might price short under a reading of K as 1024 is priced long, an over-statement bound
- built: each anthropic call's cache writes are priced at the 5m and 1h rows by the durations it records; with none recorded, all at the 1h row, the stated conservative bound (the price table's lead ruling 1), and the call's record says so
- built: each openai call's cache writes are priced at the 30m and 12h rows by the durations it records; with none recorded, all at the 12h row, the stated conservative bound (the price table's lead ruling 2), and the call's record says so
- built: every anthropic priced cost carries the label "API-equivalent, not billed: arm A runs on a subscription"
- built: every openai priced cost carries the label "API-equivalent, not billed: arm O runs on a ChatGPT subscription sign-in"
- built: cost-calls.json is assembled by cost_calls.py from every committed outcome's take folder: an arm A take's calls are its driver ledger's cost calls and the calls of each sub-agent file the take copied; an arm O take's calls are its last retained rollout's token_usage_record lines, one per response id; an arm G take's calls are its replayed session file's gemini messages that record tokens
- built: an arm O call's usage is mapped from the Responses API's counts: input is input less cached and written, cache read is cached, cache write is written, output is output; that cached input and reasoning are parts of input and output is what every recorded call shows (its total is its input plus its output); that written input is a part of input is read from the pinned source alone (openai/codex 092d3acd, codex-api/src/sse/responses.rs:128-143 and its test at :846-870), because no recorded call writes to the cache; Codex records no write duration, so its writes are priced at the 12h row, the stated bound
- built: an arm G call's usage is mapped from the session file's tokens: input is input less cached, cache read is cached, output is output plus thoughts (priced at the output row, which Google's page says includes thinking tokens); Gemini records no cache write
- built: a take whose calls cannot all be read, or checked against the totals its turn streams print (Codex's thread totals; Gemini's result stats, per model, on input, output, cached and total, so thoughts and tool-use tokens are checked together through the total, never apart), is assembled as one unmeasured call; one unmeasured call makes its vendor's priced total and the round-wide usage and priced total read unmeasured, never a partial sum
- built: on 26 Oct 2026, 32 of 36 committed arm G walks assemble as unmeasured (their session files record fewer calls than their result stats count), so arm G's priced total, and with it the round-wide total, will most likely publish as unmeasured if arm G runs
- built: an arm A take delegated when a sub-agent file was copied or its main session file holds an Agent tool call; a take that did not delegate is priced from its driver ledger's calls alone, as before, a cut or timed-out turn included
- built: a delegating arm A take's sub-agent calls are read from each sub-agent file the take copied (subagents/**/agent-<id>.jsonl, at any depth as drive.py copies it), its bytes bound by the driver ledger's sha256, because Claude Code's driver ledger records the main session file's calls alone; that file writes one call as several fragments whose output count grows, so a call is read once per message id and request id, its fragments must agree on the model, the input, cache-read and cache-write counts and the 5m and 1h write split, output may never decrease, and the last fragment is kept; any other shape makes the take one unmeasured call
- built: a delegating arm A take's calls, the main session's and its sub-agents' together, must sum per model and token class to the modelUsage the CLI prints in the last turn that prints one (the session's running total, its sub-agents included); a delegating take whose calls do not (a cut or timed-out last turn included), that has no modelUsage, or whose session calls Agent with no sub-agent file copied, is assembled as one unmeasured call, never priced from a partial sum, and that one call makes arm A's priced total, and with it the round-wide usage and priced total, read unmeasured
- built: the 5m and 1h cache-write split each arm A call records is priced as recorded and is not reconciled: modelUsage prints no split, and its own costUSD is not used as a check, because the CLI's built-in prices may differ from the frozen price table
- built: on 28 Oct 2026, 2 of 277 committed arm A walks hold a sub-agent file (w255 and w260, both Haiku 4.5 on plan-gate); with their sub-agent calls they price to $0.24809 and $0.19266, the CLI's own printed session totals, against $0.14670 and $0.05474 from their main sessions alone; 277 of 277 committed arm A walks reconcile
- built: an arm A turn's total_cost_usd in the driver ledger is the session's running total as the CLI prints it, not that turn's own, which claude_code_adapter.py lines 47-48 do not say (that file is checker code and is not edited before the freeze); no step adds it up and no call carries it, so arm A's printed total reads unmeasured and only the priced total is published
- not built in round 4: Codex's service_tier is not read, so every Codex call is priced at the table's Standard rows and never at its Fast, Ultrafast, Flex or Batch rows (the table's follow-up on the tier).
- not built in round 4: Claude Code's speed and inference_geo are not read, so every Claude call is priced at the standard rows and never at the table's fast-mode rows.
- not built in round 4: Google's hourly cache storage is not priced: it stays outside the per-token schema (the table's lead ruling 3 and its residual).
- not built in round 4: A Gemini run on or after 1 Jan 2027 is not re-priced: gemini-3.8-flash is priced at the table's price through 31 Dec 2026, and re-reading Google's page on the run day, then publishing a re-pricing as a declared deviation, needs that day's page (the table's lead ruling 5 and its follow-ups on the Gemini run day).
- not built in round 4: drive.py writes a driver ledger cost for claude-code takes only: an arm O or arm G take's ledger cost stays None, and its calls are read from the take's retained records when cost-calls.json is assembled (cost_calls.py), not by the driver (drive.py is a reader source both acceptance records bind).
- not built in round 4: Gemini's tool-use prompt tokens are not priced: the approved table names no row for them, so a Gemini take with a call that records any is assembled as one unmeasured call (cost_calls.unpriced_problem).
- not built in round 4: Arm G is not priced per take from its result stats: a take whose session file records fewer calls than its stats count stays unmeasured (pricing it from the stats is a scope that goes to Javier with arm G's go).
